newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Rain drives rubber prices down at Colombo auction.
newsitem.headline: Rain drives rubber prices down at Colombo auction.

text.p: Sri Lankan rubber prices fell at the Colombo auction on Thursday, where 178 tonnes of crepe and 13 tonnes of sheet were on offer, after rain in tapping areas lowered quality, brokers said.
"Prices fell because of bad rubber due to rain although demand was good," said a Forbes & Walker broker.
Best latex crepe one-x fell to 74.80 per kg from 75 rupees on Tuesday, when the auction was last held.
Number one fell by one rupee to 73 rupees per kg and RSS1 was unquoted after being sold for 64 rupees on Tuesday, brokers Forbes & Walker said.
